rules.title: Idempotent tasks
rules.text: Make tasks idempotent and keyed by logical date so reruns are safe.

rules.title: No heavy top-level code
rules.text: Keep DAG files light: no network calls or heavy imports at parse time.

rules.title: Small tasks
rules.text: Keep tasks small and atomic; pass references, not data, through XCom.

rules.title: Retries and timeouts
rules.text: Configure retries, timeouts and SLAs on tasks.

rules.title: Connections and secrets backend
rules.text: Store credentials in connections or a secrets backend, never in DAG code.
